identified_issues: Violation of the Rule of Direct Grounding: The automated script concluded Condition Y (Ingress Network Drop) without empirical evidence distinguishing it from Condition X (Upstream Bank Outage).
Violation of the Rule of Non-Assumption: The script assumed a safe-to-retry state in the absence of positive verification, risking duplicate debits.
Observation Nullspace: The system lacks the necessary telemetry (packet captures, cryptographic receipts, or idempotency logs) to resolve the ambiguous 504_TIMEOUT error code.
evidence: Architecture documentation confirming CODE 504_TIMEOUT is emitted identically for both Condition X and Condition Y.
Absence of wire packet capture, cryptographic sequence receipt, or idempotency reconciliation logs.
Automated script action: 'Confirmed Ingress Network Drop (Condition Y); retrying payment automatically.'
recommended_action: Disable automatic retries for CODE 504_TIMEOUT errors. Implement idempotency keys for all payment requests to ensure safe retries. Integrate local NAT firewall log checks or TCP handshake verification to positively identify Condition Y before retrying, and default to manual reconciliation (Condition X) if the state remains ambiguous.
